Citizen.title: Citizen
Citizen.description: Represents an individual user (citizen) of the FTID system, managing their personal financial data and interactions with government entities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Citizen entity.

fullName.description: The full legal name of the citizen.

email.description: The primary email address of the citizen, used for communication.

address.description: The primary residential address of the citizen.

registrationDate.description: The date and time when the citizen registered with the FTID system.

currentCreditScore.description: The citizen's current credit score, updated by the Credit Score Builder.

profileImageUrl.description: A URL to the citizen's profile image.

GovernmentEntity.title: GovernmentEntity
GovernmentEntity.description: Represents a government agency, department, or organization interacting within the FTID system, collecting taxes, distributing subsidies, or tracking economic data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the GovernmentEntity entity.

name.description: The official name of the government entity (e.g., 'Department of Treasury', 'Ministry of Health').

type.description: The classification of the government entity (e.g., 'Federal', 'State', 'Municipal', 'Agency').

contactEmail.description: The primary contact email address for the government entity.

registrationDate.description: The date and time when the government entity was registered in the FTID system.

description.description: A brief description of the government entity's role or purpose.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Records all financial transactions occurring between citizens and government entities within the FTID system, serving as the core data for analysis and dashboards.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transaction entity.

citizenId.description: Reference to the Citizen involved in this transaction. (Relationship: Citizen 1:N Transaction)

governmentEntityId.description: Reference to the GovernmentEntity involved in this transaction. (Relationship: GovernmentEntity 1:N Transaction)

amount.description: The monetary value of the transaction.

currency.description: The currency in which the transaction was made (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR').

timestamp.description: The date and time when the transaction occurred.

description.description: A brief description or purpose of the transaction.

status.description: The current status of the transaction (e.g., 'completed', 'pending', 'failed', 'reversed').

blockchainHash.description: A hash simulating a blockchain-style immutable record for this transaction.

FinancialTip.title: FinancialTip
FinancialTip.description: Stores personalized financial advice and budgeting tips generated by the AI Financial Advisor for individual citizens.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FinancialTip entity.

citizenId.description: Reference to the Citizen who received this financial tip. (Relationship: Citizen 1:N FinancialTip)

title.description: A concise title for the financial tip.

content.description: The detailed content of the financial advice or tip.

category.description: The category of the financial tip (e.g., 'budgeting', 'saving', 'debt management', 'investment').

generatedDate.description: The date and time when this financial tip was generated.

isRead.description: Indicates whether the citizen has marked this tip as read.

CreditScoreUpdate.title: CreditScoreUpdate
CreditScoreUpdate.description: Logs historical credit score changes and associated recommendations for a citizen, provided by the Credit Score Builder.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CreditScoreUpdate entity.

citizenId.description: Reference to the Citizen whose credit score was updated. (Relationship: Citizen 1:N CreditScoreUpdate)

score.description: The credit score value at the time of evaluation.

evaluationDate.description: The date and time when the credit score was evaluated and updated.

recommendations.description: A summary of recommendations provided to the citizen to improve their credit score.

TaxRecord.title: TaxRecord
TaxRecord.description: Stores details of tax calculations for a citizen for a specific period, generated by the Auto-Tax Calculator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TaxRecord entity.

citizenId.description: Reference to the Citizen for whom this tax record was generated. (Relationship: Citizen 1:N TaxRecord)

taxPeriod.description: The tax period this record pertains to (e.g., '2023-Q4', '2023-FY', '2023').

totalIncome.description: The total calculated income for the tax period.

totalDeductions.description: The total calculated deductions for the tax period.

taxableIncome.description: The income subject to tax after deductions.

calculatedTaxAmount.description: The final amount of tax calculated for the period.

calculationDate.description: The date and time when the tax calculation was performed.

transactionIds.description: References to the Transaction entities that were included in this tax calculation. (Relationship: TaxRecord N:N Transaction)

isFiled.description: Indicates whether this tax record has been officially filed.

SubsidyProgram.title: SubsidyProgram
SubsidyProgram.description: Defines a government subsidy program that citizens can apply for or receive benefits from.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SubsidyProgram entity.

name.description: The official name of the subsidy program (e.g., 'Healthcare Assistance Program').

description.description: A detailed description of the subsidy program, its goals, and benefits.

governmentEntityId.description: Reference to the GovernmentEntity that administers this subsidy program. (Relationship: GovernmentEntity 1:N SubsidyProgram)

eligibilityCriteria.description: A description of the criteria citizens must meet to be eligible for the subsidy.

amountType.description: The method used to determine the subsidy amount (e.g., 'fixed', 'variable_per_citizen', 'percentage_based').

maxAmount.description: The maximum possible amount a citizen can receive from this subsidy, if applicable.

startDate.description: The date when the subsidy program officially started.

endDate.description: The date when the subsidy program is scheduled to end.

status.description: The current operational status of the subsidy program (e.g., 'active', 'pending', 'closed', 'discontinued').

CitizenSubsidyApplication.title: CitizenSubsidyApplication
CitizenSubsidyApplication.description: Tracks a citizen's application for and receipt of a specific subsidy from a government program.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CitizenSubsidyApplication entity.

citizenId.description: Reference to the Citizen who applied for/received the subsidy. (Relationship: Citizen 1:N CitizenSubsidyApplication)

subsidyProgramId.description: Reference to the SubsidyProgram this application is for. (Relationship: SubsidyProgram 1:N CitizenSubsidyApplication)

applicationDate.description: The date and time when the citizen submitted their application.

approvalDate.description: The date and time when the application was approved, if applicable.

status.description: The current status of the subsidy application (e.g., 'applied', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected', 'disbursed').

disbursedAmount.description: The actual amount of subsidy funds disbursed to the citizen, if applicable.

transactionId.description: Reference to the Transaction entity that records the actual disbursement of the subsidy, if applicable. (Relationship: Transaction 0:1 CitizenSubsidyApplication)

InsurancePolicy.title: InsurancePolicy
InsurancePolicy.description: Stores details of a citizen's insurance policy, tracked by the Insurance/Subsidy Tracker.

id.description: Unique identifier for the InsurancePolicy entity.

citizenId.description: Reference to the Citizen who owns this insurance policy. (Relationship: Citizen 1:N InsurancePolicy)

policyNumber.description: The unique policy number assigned by the insurance provider.

providerName.description: The name of the insurance company or provider.

startDate.description: The date when the insurance policy became active.

endDate.description: The date when the insurance policy is scheduled to expire.

premiumAmount.description: The recurring payment amount for the insurance policy.

coverageDetails.description: A summary or key details of what the policy covers.

status.description: The current status of the insurance policy (e.g., 'active', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'lapsed').

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Stores messages and alerts generated by the system and sent to citizens, supporting mobile notifications.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notification entity.

citizenId.description: Reference to the Citizen who is the recipient of this notification. (Relationship: Citizen 1:N Notification)

message.description: The full content of the notification message.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the notification was generated.

isRead.description: Indicates whether the citizen has viewed or dismissed the notification.

link.description: An optional URI to a specific section of the app relevant to the notification.

FraudAlert.title: FraudAlert
FraudAlert.description: Records detected potential fraudulent activities or financial anomalies identified by the fraud detection system, which contribute to fraud heatmaps.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FraudAlert entity.

transactionId.description: Reference to a specific Transaction related to the potential fraud, if applicable. (Relationship: Transaction 0:1 FraudAlert)

governmentEntityId.description: Reference to the GovernmentEntity affected by or detecting the potential fraud, if applicable. (Relationship: GovernmentEntity 0:1 FraudAlert)

citizenId.description: Reference to the Citizen potentially involved in or affected by the fraud, if applicable. (Relationship: Citizen 0:1 FraudAlert)

alertLevel.description: The severity level of the fraud alert (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical').

description.description: A detailed description of the anomaly or potential fraudulent pattern detected.

detectionDate.description: The date and time when the fraud alert was detected.

status.description: The current investigative status of the fraud alert (e.g., 'new', 'under_investigation', 'resolved', 'false_positive').

locationDetails.description: Geographic coordinates or region identifier associated with the detected fraud for heatmap visualization (e.g., 'latitude,longitude' or 'city_id').

ElectionCampaign.title: ElectionCampaign
ElectionCampaign.description: Defines an election campaign, used for tracking related political donations and ensuring transparency.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ElectionCampaign entity.

name.description: The official name of the election campaign (e.g., 'Presidential Election 2024', 'Local City Council Run').

officeSought.description: The political office that is being sought in this campaign (e.g., 'President', 'Mayor', 'Senator').

startDate.description: The official start date of the campaign period.

endDate.description: The official end date of the campaign period.

organizingGovernmentEntityId.description: Reference to the GovernmentEntity responsible for overseeing this election (e.g., 'Election Commission'). (Relationship: GovernmentEntity 1:N ElectionCampaign)

description.description: A brief description of the election campaign.

PoliticalDonation.title: PoliticalDonation
PoliticalDonation.description: Tracks donations made to political campaigns or entities, providing transparency as part of the Election/Donation Transparency Tracker.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PoliticalDonation entity.

donorCitizenId.description: Reference to the Citizen who made the donation. (Relationship: Citizen 0:1 PoliticalDonation)

recipientName.description: The name of the recipient of the donation (e.g., 'Campaign for John Doe', 'Green Party').

amount.description: The monetary amount of the donation.

currency.description: The currency in which the donation was made.

donationDate.description: The date and time when the donation was made.

campaignId.description: Reference to the ElectionCampaign this donation is associated with, if applicable. (Relationship: ElectionCampaign 0:1 PoliticalDonation)

description.description: An optional description or purpose of the donation.

definition.description: Collection for system-wide platform administrators. Documents simply contain the UID as the ID to grant full platform access. (DBAC: Existence over Content). No specific schema provided, so using Citizen as a placeholder for basic user info if needed.

params.name: platformAdminId
params.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the platform administrator, matching request.auth.uid.

params.name: governmentEntityId

definition.description: Subcollection for administrators of a specific GovernmentEntity. Document ID (`adminId`) MUST match the user's Firebase Authentication UID. (DBAC: Existence over Content). No specific schema provided, so using Citizen as a placeholder for basic user info if needed.

params.name: governmentEntityId
params.description: The unique identifier for the government entity this admin manages.

params.name: adminId
params.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the government entity administrator, matching request.auth.uid.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed with a strong emphasis on Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and DBAC principles to ensure simple, robust, and debuggable security rules. This approach minimizes complexity and enhances security.

**1. Authorization Independence & Denormalization:**
*   **Path-Based Ownership:** For entities clearly owned by a `Citizen` (e.g., `Citizen` profile, `FinancialTip`, `CreditScoreUpdate`, `TaxRecord`, `InsurancePolicy`, `Notification`, `CitizenSubsidyApplication`), data is nested under `/citizens/{citizenId}/...`. This makes `request.path[1] == request.auth.uid` a direct authorization check, eliminating `get()` calls for ownership and enabling atomic operations.
*   **Denormalization for Collaborative/Cross-Entity Access:**
    *   For `CitizenSubsidyApplication` documents, which involve both a `Citizen` and a `GovernmentEntity` (via `SubsidyProgram`), the `administeringGovernmentEntityId` (obtained from the `SubsidyProgram`) MUST be denormalized directly into each `CitizenSubsidyApplication` document. This allows government entity administrators to query and manage applications for *their* programs (`resource.data.administeringGovernmentEntityId == request.auth.governmentEntityId`) without requiring a `get()` call to the `SubsidyProgram` document, adhering to Authorization Independence.
    *   Similarly, for `PoliticalDonation` documents, which link to an `ElectionCampaign` organized by a `GovernmentEntity`, the `campaignOrganizingGovernmentEntityId` (obtained from the `ElectionCampaign`) MUST be denormalized into each `PoliticalDonation` document. This enables `governmentEntity` administrators to manage donations related to *their* campaigns without `get()` calls on `ElectionCampaign` documents.
*   **Global Collections with Denormalized IDs:** Collections like `transactions`, `subsidyPrograms`, `fraudAlerts`, and `electionCampaigns` are top-level. Authorization for these relies on `citizenId` or `governmentEntityId` fields *within the document itself*, meaning `get()` calls for authorization are avoided.

**2. Structural Segregation (Homogeneous Security Posture):**
*   Data with different security requirements are placed in distinct collections or subcollections. For instance, private citizen data is under `/citizens/{citizenId}`, while publicly readable program definitions like `SubsidyProgram` are at the root level (`/subsidyPrograms`). This significantly simplifies security rules by allowing broader read access where appropriate and strict controls where needed, without complex conditional logic within a single rule block.

**3. DBAC (No Custom Claims) & QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
*   **Database-Backed Access Control (DBAC):** Roles are managed directly in Firestore: `/platformAdmins/{uid}` for global administrators and `/governmentEntities/{governmentEntityId}/admins/{uid}` for specific government entity administrators. Authorization checks involve simple `exists()` calls to these collections, relying on the `request.auth.uid` to establish the user's role.
*   **Queryable Authorization Predicates (QAPs):** The structure facilitates secure `list` operations.
    *   For subcollections under `/citizens/{citizenId}`, `list` operations are automatically secured as queries must target the current user's `uid` in the path.
    *   For global collections like `/transactions` and `/politicalDonations`, rules will enforce that `list` queries must include filters on `citizenId` (for citizen access) or relevant `governmentEntityId` (for government admin access). The necessary `citizenId`, `governmentEntityId`, `administeringGovernmentEntityId`, and `campaignOrganizingGovernmentEntityId` fields are denormalized within the documents, allowing rules to directly check `request.query.where('field', '==', value)` without violating Authorization Independence.
    *   Publicly accessible collections (e.g., `subsidyPrograms`, `electionCampaigns`) allow broad `list` reads, with write access restricted by DBAC roles and denormalized `governmentEntityId` fields.
